class.name: CubismModelFactory
class.brief_description: Builds validated imported model data from project sources.
class.description: Validates physical project sources and creates [CubismModelResource] data. It uses temporary SDK objects to inspect the MOC, then releases them before returning. It does not create a renderer, save a resource or register an editor importer. Texture/audio assets must already be imported by Redot. Use [CubismModelImporter] to apply the managed texture policy and persist the result.

method.name: build
method.description: Returns [code]ok[/code], bounded [code]diagnostics[/code], [code]warnings[/code] and [code]model[/code], which is null on failure. Requires a project-local model manifest with valid MOC, textures and declared motions. Missing optional files warn by default; [param strict_optional_files] makes them fail. Malformed or unsafe references always fail. Source-size, texture-size and project file-count limits apply.

method.name: build_with_options
method.description: Builds with validated import [param options], including enabled optional features, texture/rendering settings and missing-file policy. Unknown or unavailable options are rejected. The resulting resource records normalized options and dependency fingerprints; it must still pass importer texture provisioning and export validation before distribution.
